interface.signature: def doctorStrange(N: int, M: int, graph: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is between 1 and 30000 inclusive.
The number of edges M is between 1 and 30000 inclusive.
The graph list contains exactly M edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in graph)
preconditions.description: Every edge connects two nodes u and v where both are valid node indices between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for v in range(1, N + 1) if is_articulation_point(N, graph, v))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of articulation points in the graph, i.e., nodes whose removal increases the number of connected components.
